Chapter 6442: Power Of Everlasting

Chapter 6442: Power Of Everlasting

Tenacious was on the same level as Everlasting Jiang once. However, Everlasting Jiang surpassed him and caught up to Fardao.

He had entered the return path long ago. Many thought he was the most suitable as Fardao’s successor.

He became the only pillar of God Frontier after Fardao’s passing. Of course, he alone was more than enough to maintain the sect’s prestige and authority.

He preferred to live in seclusion and rarely appeared in public. Because of this, the world had few tales of him.

Fardao, Everlasting Jiang, and Tenth-gen Chen had died recently, leaving Tenacious and North Kun God as the strongest cultivators in Old World.

Both observed the final battle between Everlasting Jiang and Fardao. Did Tenacious gain as much insight as North Kun God?

North Kun God’s divinity surged enough to affect the dream strands, seemingly taking over everyone’s dreams.

“A duel, perhaps?” He challenged Tenacious, looking like a god while the rest were pretenders.

“He’s living up to the pressure of being Desolate Ancestor’s disciple.” The crowd had nothing but praise for him.

“I don’t think the situation today is favorable for you, Fellow Daoist. It is not too late to leave.” Tenacious shook his head.

Everyone could tell Tenacious couldn’t be materially stronger than North Kun God. The addition of Trinity and the origin ancestor didn’t matter. Thus, there must be another reason for his confidence.

“I want to see who can stop me.” North Kun God said unpretentiously, having no intention of yielding regardless of the odds.

“What a shame.” Tenacious lamented. The longer he stuck around, the more he became one with the dream world. A duality emerged - of him being outside yet omnipotent at once.

As North Kun God conversed with his opponents, a power traced upstream and reached the dream source.

“Who?!” North Kun God’s eyes pierced through space.

“Boom!” An explosion caused a hole in the dream world. There seemed to be an abyss on the other side. The earth source in there poured out an ancient power.

“The power of everlasting life!” Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors were shocked because this grand dao was unreachable to them.

They saw the shadow of a tree. Was this the source of all the dreams? They then noticed a figure approaching the tree.

“It’s too late, Fellow Daoists.” As North Kun God tried to rush there, Tenacious blocked his path.

Trinity and the origin ancestor flew in that direction.

“Go!” They used their primal energy to break open the dream strands, making way for the mysterious figure.

“Who is that?” Spectators had the same question since this person seemed to be one step above Trinity.

“Fine!” North Kun God used his hand as an axe, channeling all of his divinity into a single point.

Tenacious pulsed in and out of existence, using the dream world as a barrier.

Meanwhile, the mysterious figure drew near the source with the help of the primal ancestors.

“Everlasting!” The person roared, attempting to widen the hole.

“Crack!” The power of life oozed out like a tsunami and shattered dreams.

“Ahh!” The projected minds were in the dreams bellowed and immediately met their demise.

Displacements happened everywhere. Some areas advanced by ten thousand years in the blink of an eye while others surged forward millions of years.

In Gold Village, golden trees grew far faster. In Paramount, the kingdom experienced numerous cycles of rise and fall.

Because of this, many cultivators in reality died while those who found cultivation success in the dreams were stuck, unable to escape.

Outside in the real world, Li Qiye had left the abyss with a skull on his shoulder. He glanced at the dream world and frowned: “It’s maturing rapidly, on the verge of becoming reality.”

“Fuck, who planted this dream on my sacred ground?” The skull cursed: “Taking advantage of me while I’m down, is that it?”
